title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(近藤泰光研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Kondo Yasumitsu)
educationalGoal: Using the basic academic skills that students have learned in this Department of Mechanical Engineering, students acquire the ability to discover and solve different technical problems in mechanical engineering-related fields by themselves, in order to create new technologies that are necessary for researching, developing, designing and manufacturing useful and high-quality products. Students will also learn the importance of collaboration with society, especially the local community.
advice: The educational aim of the Department of Mechanical Engineering is to develop mechanical engineers who acquire basic knowledge of mechanical engineering, can design application technology, manufacturing new materials, and their processing methods, and also respond technology related to the environment and energy. PD III is the final subject of the department, and in order to realize the educational goals of the department, the emphasis is placed on developing the ability to set up proper models to describe phenomena, to analyze and solve the problems using the models, and to develop the ability to make engineering evaluations based on the obtained results. In practice, the students check the project proposals prepared by the teachers in the individual laboratories and in the specialist seminars, review them if necessary, and carry out the process of problem finding and solving according to the content of the proposals. Students will also understand the objectives of the subject and the outline and achievement goals based on the syllabus. It is important that student will understand which part of the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering this subject is responsible for and the specific level of the achievement. This laboratory mainly approach the subjects concerning high temperature oxidation of metals. These subjects are related real industrial situation.

activityGoals.body: To be able to carry out the projects with the proper engineering design.
To be able to write technical reports of their work and discuss them in a presentation.
To be able to act independently on other presented items.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1)The student understand the purpose and process of the project theme accurately, and be able to achieve annual goals. The student is able to report on the process through the PD Activity Support System. 2)The student is able to summarize the results of the project activities as a mid-term report, and to present and discuss the contents of the report. Students is able to compile the final results as a final report, and present and discuss them at the PD III public reviewing. Students is able to publish the final results in an academic conference appropriate to their area and receive an external evaluation.3)The student is able to design and manufacture and evaluate your own products as required.
achievementLevels.standard: 1)The student understand the purpose and process of the project theme accurately, and be able to achieve annual goals. The student is able to report on the process through the PD Activity Support System. 2)The student is able to summarize the results of the project activities as a mid-term report, and to present the contents of the report. Students is able to compile the final results as a final report, and present them at the PD III public reviewing. 3)The student is able to design and manufacture your own products as required.

lessons.content: Submitted proposal in the previous semester is revised as necessary.
Previous research is investigated through PD reports and literature surveys. A research plan is developed and experiments and surveys are carried out.
Mid-term presentation is conducted at the end of first semester.
Pre-print report is compiled and submitted in July.
Final report is submitted in February.
The researched content is presented at the PD public reviewing in February.
Final report is uploaded in February.
